canonical_failfast_vs_standalone: Canonical umbrella retains FAIL and later UNRUN at exact observed failure. Independently invoked successor has separate command/env/stdout/JUnit/outcome receipt; it cannot rewrite canonical UNRUN or certify complete CI. Root may invoke ready independent selectors on frozen source once without waiting for unrelated doctor/import-policy green.
